message:
Add Dark Reactor Overclock for Lai'tela's Reality

Overclock #32 costs 1e50 Reality Machines and unlocks with Lai'tela.
Inside Lai'tela's Reality it removes the IP/EP dilation penalty and
raises Antimatter, Infinity and Time Dimension multipliers to
^(1.5 + 0.25 per destabilized Dimension). It does not affect speed.

Upgrade bits now use id % 32, so id 32 is stored in the unused bit 0
instead of relying on JavaScript's shift wraparound.
